title: Guardian RAG
value: Enterprise RAG with security built into retrieval.
description: Access-controlled retrieval, passage-level classification, PostgreSQL row-level security and tamper-evident auditing — filtering sensitive context before it ever reaches the model.

images.alt: Guardian RAG showing a cited answer and confidential source passage for an HR manager
images.caption: Actual project interface · HR manager view

detailsTitle: The right answer, for the right person.
detailsHtml:
A policy assistant must respect the permissions of the person asking. Guardian RAG checks access before search, enforces it inside PostgreSQL, and checks again before returning an answer. The example interface shows an HR manager receiving a cited answer from a confidential section; the same question is withheld for other roles.

Question + role→Permission-aware search→Cited answer + audit

Capability demonstrated: secure retrieval, database access control, and auditable AI system design.

title: AutoFT
value: Models that know when they need to improve.
description: A self-maintaining LLM pipeline that detects performance drift, fine-tunes locally with QLoRA, and promotes a model only when it measurably outperforms production.

images.alt: AutoFT training run and model promotion check with the result HOLD

detailsHtml:
AutoFT watches real questions, statistically detects distribution drift, decides whether retraining is worth the GPU time, and fine-tunes on local hardware. A held-out evaluation compares the candidate with the incumbent. In its documented run, the promotion gate returned HOLD because the improvement was within measurement noise.

Capability demonstrated: model evaluation, automated fine-tuning, and production ML lifecycle engineering.

title: KRONOS
value: Build and orchestrate AI agents visually.
description: A local-first environment for designing, running, evaluating and fine-tuning multi-agent workflows — bringing orchestration and experimentation into one workspace.

images.alt: KRONOS visual agent canvas with a document collection, tool-calling agent, and live trace

detailsTitle: From a workflow to its whole lifecycle.
detailsHtml:
KRONOS connects agents, retrieval, data processing, fine-tuning, and evaluation through a visual canvas. The supplied screenshot shows an agent answering from a document collection with a live trace. The public showcase documents the architecture; implementation source is available for review on request.

Capability demonstrated: agent orchestration, visual workflow design, and integrated AI evaluation.

title: Swarminal
value: A development environment built for parallel AI agents.
description: A desktop IDE where terminal panes run shells and coding agents simultaneously. Divide work across agents, monitor sessions, and coordinate development in one workspace.

images.alt: Swarminal desktop showing six real terminal panes for multiple coding agents and shells
images.caption: Actual project interface · BridgeMind-PTY build

detailsTitle: Real terminals, working side by side.
detailsHtml:
Built by Mazen Sarwat Ismail, Swarminal combines an Electron desktop shell, a React interface, and node-pty terminal sessions. Each pane can run a shell or CLI coding agent, keeping parallel sessions visible in a single workspace.

Capability demonstrated: desktop engineering, terminal integration, and tools for parallel agent development.

title: Nest Invest
description: A trading simulation platform combining financial workflows with an LSTM forecasting service, exploring how predictive ML integrates into interactive investment systems.

detailsHtml:
Nest Invest is a graduation project graded A, with AI engineering by Yousef and frontend engineering by Osama. A MERN application connects interactive trading simulation with an LSTM forecasting service. The frontend uses React, Tailwind, Recharts, and React Query. Source code is private.

React interface→Application APIs→LSTM forecasting

Capability demonstrated: predictive ML integration, data visualization, and full-stack product delivery.

title: DocViewer
value: A workspace for the knowledge behind the code.
description: A documentation viewer that brings Markdown, HTML, syntax-highlighted code, and Mermaid diagrams into one workspace — with split editing, document history, and CLI integration for agent-generated reports.

images.alt: DocViewer rendering a Markdown reference document with preview, raw and split modes, and document actions
images.caption: Actual project interface · Markdown preview

images.alt: DocViewer source editor and live preview side by side
images.caption: Split editing: source and live preview

detailsTitle: Keep the thinking connected to the work.
detailsHtml:
Built by Mazen Sarwat Ismail, DocViewer makes engineering documents easier to read, edit, and navigate. Its documented features include a tabbed workspace, live Markdown preview, syntax-highlighted code, searchable navigation, Mermaid rendering with pan and zoom, HTML preview, and document history.

The React and TypeScript interface runs inside a Tauri desktop shell. A cached rendering pipeline brings together Markdown parsing, code highlighting, and diagram rendering. The desktop CLI can create a UTF-8 document and open it in the viewer; Claude Code live mode follows documents written by an agent without taking focus from an already-open workspace.

Files + CLI / agent output→Rendering + cache→Preview / source / split

Capability demonstrated: desktop product engineering, document rendering, developer workflow integration, and usable interfaces for technical knowledge.
